proof_boundary: This proves an exact all-carrier auxiliary homotopy, its physical retained-current anchor, six-moment full-support closure, edge-only external row, terminal interval and reciprocal-strip identities, outer nonstationary gaps, and a terminal phase-displacement bound. It proves no bound for the edge-composed outer complement, no quadratic remainder estimate, signed full-current or Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Q209, cofinal descendant theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: omega_T=omega_E+omega_C(Omega), where omega_C is the carrier tail B<n<=N and omega_E is the genuine endpoint edge.
rows.claim: The terminal carrier block is separated from the genuine endpoint edge.

rows.certificate: omega=(V,mathcal N,A,Q) and Q(omega)=omega^T J omega=Vmathcal N-AQ.
rows.claim: The four observations carry one universal projective current.

rows.certificate: Psi_B=Q(omega_B)+2omega_T^T J omega_B and Psi_B(Omega)=h^2Phi_B.
rows.claim: The prior auxiliary flow is the bulk self-current plus its frozen-terminal cross current.
rows.proof_boundary: The terminal self-current is not in Psi_B.

rows.certificate: tilde(Psi)(xi)=Q(omega_E+omega_B(xi)+omega_C(xi)).
rows.claim: Moving the terminal carriers with the bulk defines one exact retained-current homotopy.

rows.certificate: tilde(Psi)(Omega)=Q(omega_T+omega_B(Omega))=h^2P_ret.
rows.claim: The new homotopy equals the complete retained current at the physical frequency.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a sign theorem.

rows.certificate: tilde(Psi)'=2(omega_E+omega_B+omega_C)^T J(dot(omega_B)+dot(omega_C)).
rows.claim: The full homotopy derivative preserves all carrier self and cross terms.

rows.certificate: tilde(Psi)'-Psi_B'=2[omega_C(xi)-omega_C(Omega)]^TJdot(omega_B)+2[omega_E+omega_B+omega_C(xi)]^TJdot(omega_C).
rows.claim: The difference from the frozen-terminal derivative is an explicit moving-tail defect.

rows.certificate: G_j^[N]=G_j^[B]+G_j^(C), 0<=j<=5, with G_j^(C) summed over B<n<=N under the same auxiliary rotation.
rows.claim: The all-carrier homotopy still closes on six moments.

rows.certificate: For Y=y_B+y_C, tilde(Psi)'=Y^TM_xiY+ell_E^TY, where ell_E=U_1(2Jomega_E).
rows.claim: The full-support flow uses the same rank-eight matrix with an edge-only linear row.

rows.certificate: The terminal carriers now live in Y; only the genuine endpoint edge remains in the external linear row.
rows.claim: Terminal carriers are internal moment data rather than an external terminal row.
rows.proof_boundary: The genuine edge is not deleted.

rows.certificate: For Y=p+r, the linear remainder is one degree-at-most-five P_lin^[N]=F_alpha+i(lambda-log a)F_beta with beta=(mathcal N_p+mathcal N_E,V_p+V_E,-Q_p-Q_E,-A_p-A_E).
rows.claim: The full-support linear residual remains one physical polynomial amplitude.

rows.certificate: The nonlinear remainder remains epsilon_Vepsilon_(N,xi)+epsilon_Nepsilon_(V,xi)-epsilon_Aepsilon_(Q,xi)-epsilon_Qepsilon_(A,xi).
rows.claim: The nonlinear residual remains exactly four observation pairings.

rows.certificate: H^[N][A]=H^[B][A]+sum_(q=B+1)^N A(q)e(alpha_Plog q).
rows.claim: Extending B to N adds exactly the terminal carrier samples.
The two starred Poisson sums differ by the terminal interval with half weights at B and N.

rows.certificate: I_(A,N)(r)=I_(A,B)(r)+integral_B^N A(u)e(alpha_Plog u-ru)du.
rows.claim: Each complete Fourier mode acquires exactly the continuous terminal interval.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a discrete tail approximation.

rows.certificate: The B endpoint half is transferred into the terminal interval; it must not be retained simultaneously as a hard endpoint of both transforms.
rows.claim: The old B hard half cannot coexist with the new full-support endpoint accounting.
rows.proof_boundary: Double counting would invalidate the join.

rows.certificate: The cells 1<=q<=N tile (alpha_P/(N+1/2),2alpha_P].
rows.claim: The full-support reciprocal cells tile one contiguous band.

rows.certificate: The cells B+1<=q<=N tile (alpha_P/(N+1/2),alpha_P/(B+1/2)].
rows.claim: The newly added cells form exactly the terminal strip.
rows.proof_boundary: No cells are enumerated in production.

rows.certificate: Their diagonal inversions return q=B+1,...,N-1 with full weight and q=N with half weight; the upper hard endpoint supplies the other half at N.
rows.claim: The terminal strip returns the terminal physical samples with the correct endpoint half.

rows.certificate: The full-support scalar transform is still Fourier inversion. Its value is the alignment of the terminal strip and endpoint edge, not scalar smallness.
rows.claim: Full-support scalar re-Poissonization is still exact inversion.

rows.certificate: For r<=alpha_P/(N+1/2) and 1<=u<=N, alpha_P/u-r>=alpha_P/[2N(N+1/2)]>1/4 on the physical segment.
rows.claim: The low outer complement is uniformly nonstationary.
rows.proof_boundary: Endpoint transition size is not bounded.

rows.certificate: For r>2alpha_P and 1<=u<=N, r-alpha_P/u>alpha_P.
rows.claim: The high outer complement has a much larger phase-gradient gap.

rows.certificate: For n=N-m in the terminal block, u_n<2hK and |z_n(xi)-z_n(Omega)|<7h^3K|z_n(Omega)|/(4L^2)<h^3K|z_n(Omega)|.
rows.claim: Moving a terminal carrier over the short auxiliary segment changes only a tiny phase.
rows.proof_boundary: No joined row norm is assumed.

rows.certificate: These gaps prove nonstationarity only. They do not bound the endpoint-composed outer complement at h^2 scale.
rows.claim: The next estimate belongs to the full-support observation kernel with the edge and outer complement joined.
rows.proof_boundary: Scalar absolute exterior budgets remain invalid.

rows.certificate: Bound tilde(Psi)(T_0)-epsilon integral tilde(Psi)' below zero, using terminal-strip alignment, outer-complement cancellation, and the four quadratic pairings before any modulus.
rows.claim: Prove or falsify the edge-composed full-support retained-current inequality.
rows.proof_boundary: No such signed bound is proved here.

rows.certificate: alpha_P=xi/(2pi), e(x)=exp(2pi i x), and kappa=1/(2pi i); no fitted circle or polygon is introduced.
rows.claim: Every pi remains fixed by the completed-zeta and Fourier normalizations.

rows.certificate: No edge-complement bound, signed full-current theorem, Phi_B theorem, Xi theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion is claimed.
rows.claim: The full-support homotopy is a route reduction, not the missing estimate.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a proof of RH.
